summary: Intermap Technologies filed a 6-K announcing a definitive arrangement agreement to acquire PCI Geomatics Group. Terms: $11 million cash for all PCI shares not already owned by Intermap. The transaction is a statutory arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act. PCI's CEO June McAlarey will stay on as EVP at Intermap. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal; voting support agreements are in place with major shareholder Grenadier and PCI's directors/officers. A special PCI shareholder meeting will be held to vote. What to watch: timeline to closing and any shareholder opposition; no premium or break fee stated.
